LLM_description:
Situation:
Brigade combat elements are dispersed across a contested area of operations. Forward Operating Base Alpha, the 3rd Infantry Battalion, and the Combat Support Hospital require sustained resupply. Supply Depot Bravo, Central Ammunition Point Sierra, and Medical Supply Node Lima hold mixed stocks but face throughput and security constraints. Key ground lines of communication, including the River Valley MSR and High Ridge Trail, are intermittently interdicted by enemy activity and improvised explosive devices. Weather and terrain limit maneuver speed, and engineer route clearance assets are finite. Airlift is prioritized for casualty evacuation and not available for bulk resupply. Distribution will be phased over successive days to maintain tempo while adapting to evolving security conditions.

Mission:
Deliver required supply classes from depots to all supported units within the sustainment window while minimizing total operational cost, comprising transport costs, shortage penalties, vehicle deployment costs, and fixed route security risk costs.

Execution/Concept:
- Prioritize life-support and mission-critical demands for FOB Alpha, maneuver battalions, and medical facilities. Employ controlled slack only when risk or capacity constraints prevent full delivery, acknowledging associated penalty costs.
- Consolidate shipments to reduce the number of activated routes. Activating any route (sending any vehicles) incurs a fixed Risk Cost for security overhead (escort teams, route clearance, ISR coverage), regardless of the number of vehicles employed on that route. Minimize activated routes to limit cumulative risk overhead.
- Select depots by supply class and day to respect depot capacity limits; outbound flows from each depot will not exceed available stocks. Balance depot draws to prevent overcommitting any single node.
- Assign vehicles to depot–unit pairs subject to fleet size limits and vehicle capacity. Load planning will account for supply volumes to maximize utilization without exceeding capacity. Vehicles can only operate on routes designated active for that day.
- Sequence convoys along the most defensible corridors, coordinating engineer, EOD, and security elements for route clearance and overwatch. Avoid the River Valley MSR during periods of high interdiction; divert via High Ridge Trail when feasible.
- Staging areas at Supply Depot Bravo and CAP Sierra will form convoy packages by destination, consolidating multi-class loads to reduce route activations and line-haul movements. Maintain flexibility to retask vehicles as threats or weather shift.
- Control measures: Movement tables, route activation orders, and convoy tasking will be published each phase. The sustainment cell will monitor execution, adjust depot assignments, and authorize slack where risk or fleet limits are binding.
